---
title: "Tech Stack"
---

-   Development IDE: Positron
-   Python Version: 3.14.5
    -   check your python version with `python –-version`
-   We don't install Python libraries globally - we *always* work within a virtual envrionment
-   A Unix/Linux-based terminal (this comes by default in Positron)
-   Git, used in the terminal 
    -   `git --version` for Nikko is 2.39.5 (Apple Git-154)
